The Digital Humanities as a Chance to Show Off

Elijah Meeks

Originally published at Digital Humanities Specialist. This edition preserves the original text and historical context.

DH11 is coming up soon and, given that I had to take out a second mortgage to pay the registration fee, I’m going to make sure to have a host of beautiful and perhaps even informative visualizations of the work going on here at Stanford as well as, if the stars are right, a few interesting representations of the conference itself.
